==About==

A {{i|Myrtle Oak Acorn}} can be Picked from a {{i|Myrtle Oak Tree}}, or found by chance when Rummaging though a {{i|Squirrel Stash}}. {{i|Roasted Myrtle Acorns}} are obtained when using a Myrtle Oak Acorn with the {{i|Roasted Nuts}} recipe, additionally, with the [[Nut Orchards]] Skill learned, a Myrtle Oak Acorn can be planted in a {{i|Gardening Pot}} to grow a Myrtle Oak Tree. Planting in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Myrtle Oak Acorn can be stored in a {{i|NutSack}}.
